questions.question: What does self-assessment mean?
options: Evaluating your own skills and progress honestly and realistically
Letting the teacher do all the evaluation
Comparing yourself to the best student in class
questions.explanation: Self-assessment means honestly evaluating your own skills and progress, so you know what to work on.

questions.question: Which four main skills are assessed in the English subject?
questions.explanation: English assessment covers the four main skills: listening, reading, writing and speaking.

questions.question: What does the S in SMART goals stand for?
questions.explanation: SMART goals are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound. A specific goal states exactly what you want to achieve.

questions.question: Which of these is a SMART learning goal?
options: "I will learn 20 new English words about the environment before Friday."
"I will be perfect at everything soon."
questions.explanation: A SMART goal is specific, measurable and time-bound - "20 new words before Friday" can be checked, unlike vague goals like "become better".

questions.question: What is the best way to use feedback from your teacher?
options: Read it carefully and use it to improve your next piece of work
Ignore it and only look at the grade
questions.explanation: Feedback tells you what to improve. Using it actively in your next assignment is how you make progress.
